title: Setpoint policy layer
description: A Setpoint layer file: baseline.yml, groups/<name>.yml or repos/<target>/<project-or-owner>/<repo>.yml.

version.description: The policy format version. Must be 1.

layer.description: Which layer this file is: baseline, group or repo.

name.description: The group's name. Groups only; it must match the file name.

repo.description: The repo this override is for, as <target>/<project-or-owner>/<repo>. Repo overrides only; it must match the file path.

selectors.description: Explicit repos or globs over <target>/<project-or-owner>/<repo> that put repos in this group. Groups only.

locked.description: Rules that groups and repo overrides may not change. Baseline only.

enabled.description: false means the setting must be absent.

count.description: How many approvals are needed. GitHub allows at most 10.

resetOnPush.description: Whether a new push to the source branch resets existing approvals.

minimumReviewers.description: Approvals required before a pull request can complete. ~ leaves it unmanaged; enabled: false removes it.

name.description: The status check context on GitHub, or the pipeline name on Azure DevOps.

requiredChecks.description: Checks that must pass before a pull request can complete. On Azure DevOps each name is a pipeline, enforced as build validation. An empty list removes them.

requireCommentResolution.description: All review comments must be resolved before a pull request can complete. false removes the setting.

allowedMergeTypes.description: The merge types a pull request may complete with. Must not be empty.

protectFromForcePushAndDelete.description: The default branch can't be force-pushed or deleted. false removes the protection.

access.description: Team and group permissions on the repo: a team slug (GitHub) or group name (Azure DevOps) to read, write, admin, or none to remove the access Setpoint manages. Principals not listed are left alone. A lower layer replaces the whole map.

enabled.description: false removes the approvals, wait and branch restriction, and keeps the environment.

reviewers.description: Who must approve a deployment: team slugs on GitHub (users go in github.environments), group or user names on Azure DevOps. An empty list removes the approvals.

waitMinutes.description: Minutes to wait before a deployment starts, from 0 (none) to 43200 (30 days).

branches.description: Which branches may deploy: default (the default branch, or protected branches on GitHub) or any.

environments.description: Deployment environments and their approvals, by environment name. Environments not listed are left alone; a missing one is created, and none is ever deleted. A lower layer replaces the whole map.

rules.description: The neutral rules this layer sets.

creatorVoteCounts.description: The pull request creator's own vote counts toward the minimum.

allowDownvotes.description: A pull request can complete even when some reviewers vote 'waiting' or 'rejected'.

blockLastPusherVote.description: The vote of the person who pushed most recently does not count.

minimumReviewers.description: Azure DevOps options for the neutral minimumReviewers rule.

validDuration.description: Minutes a build validation result stays valid. 0 means it never expires.

pathFilters.description: Paths that trigger build validation, in Azure DevOps filter syntax, such as /src/*.

name.description: The status name the external service posts.

genre.description: The status genre, if the service sets one.

statusChecks.description: External status checks that must succeed, posted by other services rather than Azure Pipelines.

requiredChecks.description: Azure DevOps options for the neutral requiredChecks rule.

allowRebaseMerge.description: Also allow rebase with a merge commit (semi-linear merge).

allowedMergeTypes.description: Azure DevOps options for the neutral allowedMergeTypes rule.

azuredevops.description: Options that exist only on Azure DevOps, grouped under the neutral rule they extend.

requireCodeOwnerReview.description: A code owner must approve changes to files they own.

requireLastPushApproval.description: The most recent push must be approved by someone other than the person who pushed it.

pullRequest.description: Pull request options with no neutral equivalent.

strict.description: The branch must be up to date with the default branch before merging.

integrationIds.description: Pins a check to the GitHub App that must report it: check name to App id.

requiredChecks.description: GitHub-only options for the neutral requiredChecks rule.

actorType.description: What kind of actor this is.

actorId.description: The team, App, role or deploy key id. Not used for organizationAdmin.

bypassMode.description: When the actor may bypass: always, or only through a pull request.

bypassActors.description: Who may bypass the setpoint ruleset. Nobody may unless this is declared.

access.description: GitHub-only roles for the neutral access rule: a team slug to triage or maintain. A team can't be in both access and github.access.

users.description: Users who must approve a deployment, by login. Teams go in the neutral reviewers; together at most 6. An empty list removes the user reviewers.

preventSelfReview.description: true keeps the person who started a deployment from approving it.

environments.description: GitHub-only options for the neutral environments rule, by environment name: users who must approve, and whether the person who started a deployment may approve it.

github.description: Options that exist only on GitHub. They apply to the setpoint ruleset.
